name: The Company
desc: Owns the station, the rent, the air and the paperwork. Writes in memos.
notes: Sends the recurring tithe (one template per phase), rent and wage memos, and issues licensed discs. Never a person, always a notice.

name: Spine clinic
desc: The clinic on the mid decks. Staple medical orders, thin pay, urgent.
notes: Pays 0.85-1.0 of market. Its rush orders follow epidemics; its charity orders keep someone alive.

name: Works union
desc: Foundry and fab hall workers. Strike notices, bulk staples and spares for the halls.
notes: Bulk buys of bread, yeast and returned filters; sends strike notices as memos.

name: Ring council
desc: Elected residents of the ring. Festivals, luxury bulk, complaints.
notes: Pays 1.6-1.8 of market. Complaint memos when deliveries are late.

name: Parcel carrier
desc: Moves sealed boxes between decks. Pickup notices, tier letters, delays.
notes: Sells nothing but sends notices; also buys packing stock.

name: No letterhead
desc: No letterhead, no name. Contraband orders and cracked attachments.
notes: Every attachment here is a bad idea; the black orders carry exempt discs (fire blueprints, narcotics, cracked software).

name: Station security
desc: Inspections, seizures and fines. Sometimes buys locks and alarms.
notes: Sends notice letters ahead of inspections; its orders buy alarms and locks.
